buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up

to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. The bidder shall submit a self-attested copy of the PAN Card. 2. The bidder shall submit a self-attested copy of the GST Registration Certificate, wherever GST registrat ion is applicable. 3. The bidder shall submit a copy of a cancelled cheque or bank account proof bearing the name of the bi dder / firm. 4. This bid is reserved for eligible Local Bidders having geographical presence in Tamil Nadu, subject to t he applicable GeM provisions and procurement rules. 5. The bidder shall submit a valid Company / Firm Registration Certificate or other proof of legal constitut ion of the business, as applicable. 6. The bidder shall submit a valid Udyam Registration / MSME Certificate, if claiming the benefits or prefe rence applicable to Micro and Small Enterprises. 7. The bidder shall submit a declaration on the company / firm letterhead, duly signed and stamped, stati ng that the bidder has not been blacklisted or debarred by any Government Department, Government Ag ency, Local Body or Public Sector Undertaking as on the date of bid submission. 8. The bidder shall submit copies of the latest three months’ GSTR-3B returns, wherever applicable, alon g with the latest Income Tax Return acknowledgement / relevant Income Tax document. 9. The Monoblock Motor / Pump set offered shall be brand-new, unused, genuine and of good quality, suit able for the intended Government institutional use. The bidder shall clearly mention the make, brand, mo del and country of origin (where required) of the product quoted. Refurbished, reconditioned or used prod ucts shall not be accepted. 10. The bidder shall submit a duly signed and stamped Warranty / Quality Assurance Undertaking along with the bid. The undertaking shall clearly specify the brand, make, model and warranty period of the quot ed Monoblock Motor / Pump set, and shall cover manufacturing defects and replacement / repair support i n accordance with the tender conditions. Failure to submit the required undertaking may result in rejectio n of the bid. 11. Bidders having their business establishment in Salem District and nearby districts alone shall be eligi ble to participate, subject to the applicable GeM rules and the conditions of this bid. The bidder shall subm it valid documentary proof of the business address. 12. The bidder shall have prior experience in supplying Monoblock Motors / Pump Sets or similar electrica l / pumping equipment to Government Departments, Local Bodies, Public Sector Undertakings or other ins titutions, wherever such experience is prescribed in the bid. Copies of relevant purchase orders / supply or ders and completion or performance certificates shall be furnished as proof. 13. The bidder shall submit the applicable manufacturer’s technical datasheet, catalogue and test / inspe ction certificate for the quoted Monoblock Motor / Pump set. The documents shall establish compliance wi th the technical specifications prescribed in the BOQ / tender. BIS / ISI certification shall be submitted whe rever it is mandatory or specifically prescribed for the product. 14. Product demonstration is mandatory before the opening of the bid. The bidder shall bring and demon strate the quoted Mono block Motor / Pump Set, along with the required sample, at the Valapady Block Office before the scheduled bid opening date and time. The product shall be made available for inspection and technical evaluation by the Purchaser / Tender Evaluation Committee. Failure to bring and demonstra te the product before the opening of the bid shall result in rejection of the bid. 15. The bidder shall specifically confirm the availability of local after-sales service support, including serv ice contact details, service location and the procedure for attending complaints. The bidder shall ensure p rompt service, repair and warranty support during the 2 years warranty period of the motor.

16. The bidder shall mandatorily submit a duly signed and stamped Rate Statement along with the bid, cl early indicating the unit rate, applicable taxes and total amount for each BOQ item. The quoted rate shall include all costs required for supply and delivery, unless otherwise specified in the BOQ. Failure to submit the required Rate Statement may result in rejection of the bid. 17. The quoted rate shall be inclusive of packing, forwarding, loading, transportation, unloading and deliv ery charges up to the specified delivery location. No separate transportation or incidental charges shall b e paid by the Purchaser. 18. Delivery Location: The Special Officer, Chandra pillai valasu Panchayat, Valapady Union, Salem Distri ct, Tamil Nadu. The successful bidder shall deliver the materials within the delivery period specified in the GeM contract / purchase order. 19. The successful bidder shall supply the Monoblock Motor / Pump set strictly in accordance with the ap proved make, model and technical specifications. Any change in brand, model or specification shall requir e prior written approval of the Purchaser. 20. The supplied Monoblock Motor / Pump set shall be inspected at the delivery location. The Purchaser r eserves the right to reject any item that is damaged, defective, non-genuine or not in conformity with the tender specifications. Rejected items shall be replaced by the supplier at no additional cost within the peri od stipulated by the Purchaser. 21. The supplier shall provide the original warranty card, user / installation manual, invoice and all other documents supplied by the manufacturer along with the product. 22. Payment shall be made only after satisfactory delivery, inspection and acceptance of the materials, a nd submission of the required invoice and supporting documents, in accordance with the applicable GeM t erms and Government rules. . 3. Service & Support Dedicated /toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support : BIDDER/OEM must have Dedicated/toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support. 4. Service & Support Escalation Matrix For Service Support : Bidder/OEM must provide Escalation Matrix of Telephone Numbers for Service Support.
